mapper.select: select id, corpid, customer_id, contact_name, mobile, default_flag, creator_id, modify_id from customer_contact where corpid = #{corpid} and customer_id = #{customerId} and del = 0 order by id
mapper.update: update customer_contact set del = 1 where corpid = #{corpid} and customer_id = #{customerId} and del = 0
update customer_contact set del = 1 where corpid = #{corpid} and customer_id = #{customerId} and del = 0 and id not in #{id}

update customer_contact set contact_name = #{contactName}, mobile = #{mobile}, default_flag = #{defaultFlag}, modify_id = #{modifyId}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and corpid = #{corpid} and customer_id = #{customerId} and del = 0
